announcement.text: Get a clear quote on WhatsApp

hero.tag: Made to order, built to last
hero.text: Made-to-order sofa sets, beds, wardrobes, dining tables and office furniture in {city}. Choose a ready design or tell us your size, style and budget, and our craftsmen will build it for you.

footer.about: Made-to-order furniture for homes, shops and offices in {city}. Tell us your size, we send a clear price.

faqs.q: Can you make furniture to my size?
faqs.a: Yes. We build beds, wardrobes, sofas, tables and more to your measurements, so the piece fits your room properly.

faqs.q: How do I get a price?
faqs.a: Send us a photo, your measurements or an idea on WhatsApp ({phone}). We reply with a clear price and timeline.

faqs.q: Can I choose the finish and colour?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick a wood tone or colour, or send us a photo of the look you want and we will match it where we can.

faqs.q: What is the price of a sofa set, bed or wardrobe?
faqs.a: Prices start at {from} and depend on the size, wood or board, fabric and finish. {examples} Send us your size and we give you the exact price before we start.

faqs.q: Can you make a full bed set?
faqs.a: Yes. We build beds with storage and dressing tables, and we can plan them to match each other. Tell us which pieces you need and your mattress size.
We can deliver and help with setup in {city}. Tell us your area when you ask for a quote and we will confirm the details.

faqs.q: Can I see examples of your work?
faqs.a: Yes. You can see our latest pieces and customer reviews on our Facebook page and our Google page.
